corridor_responsibilities.duty: GALLUS supplies early chip; Steward owns artillery death. Ordinary ground blocking contributes nothing against this flying enemy.
Midnight clears roadblock #3 early, maintains officer interception, then clears roadblock #1 on his final deployment. Observe the civilian's actual arrival.
Melantha clears roadblock #4 before the second civilian arrives, retains lower-outer interception, then clears roadblock #2. Observe actual arrival.
Fang remains the upper-inner blocker. Ansel sustains him; Midnight's second arts window must remove the first upper armor before the second late runner would overflow Fang's two slots.
Friston blocks; GALLUS continuously damages this lane. Returning Steward adds armor-priority arts. The older armor must leave a slot before final armor #34 arrives.
Midnight retains upper-outer interception through the last officer. There is no unsupported Fang bridge.
Melantha retains lower-outer interception under ordinary Hibiscus coverage until the last officer dies.

Early crossfire, eastern upper roadblock destruction, upper-outer interception and timed inner armor assistance.
Permanent lower-inner blocking under GALLUS damage and Hibiscus healing.
Early western artillery chip and permanent lower-inner arts damage.
Lower-outer interception and eastern lower roadblock destruction.
Heal Friston, Melantha, GALLUS and herself.
Heal Fang, Midnight and eastern Steward.
Finish artillery across its eastern vertical flight.
Returning arts damage directly covers both inner holders.
Destroy the western upper roadblock after upper-outer combat.
Destroy the western lower roadblock after lower-outer combat.

formation_structure.configuration: Use the supplied debug configurations. Credit GALLUS only with its supported generic single-target arts attack; credit no unsupported talent.
formation_structure.impact_separation: Steward [2,7] is two tiles from Ansel. Hibiscus [5,6] is diagonally separated from Friston and Melantha by sqrt(2), and three tiles from GALLUS. These distances exceed the supplied 1.2 splash radius.
formation_structure.lower_medicine: Hibiscus [5,6] LEFT covers Friston [4,5], Melantha [6,5] and GALLUS [5,3].
formation_structure.midnight_crossfire: Midnight [1,5] UP covers both [3,5] and [4,5], but his own blocked enemies take precedence. His armor contribution must subtract outer interception time.

opening_economy.dependency: Fang must survive through the third grant. No retreat refund funds the opening.

formation_structure.permanent_lower_arts: GALLUS [5,3] RIGHT covers Friston [4,5]. A lower armored enemy held there is sqrt(5) away from GALLUS, outside its source-backed 2.2 ranged attack radius.

redeployment_accounting.client_cost_escalation: UNKNOWN; current executor uses the stated unchanged costs.

formation_structure.upper_medicine: Ansel [2,5] RIGHT covers Fang [3,5], Midnight [1,5] and Steward [2,7].

Midnight's second skill supplies actual arts damage during first-armor contact, interrupted by his upper-outer blocking duties.
Steward returns centrally after 2101 frames of cooldown. GALLUS has retained lower-inner damage throughout this interval.
Withdraw Midnight after all upper-outer enemies are dead.
Withdraw Melantha after all lower-outer enemies are dead.

Return Melantha to destroy the western lower roadblock.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: The listed/deployed union is exactly eight normal-mode rarity-1-to-3 IDs. GALLUS counts toward this limit despite being a robot.
Every deployment uses the declared integer [row,col] and direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Fang survives the third DP grant; Friston survives until Hibiscus supplies actual healing. Failed conditional income is a survival failure.
Only its explicitly supported generic arts attack is used. Its overall NOT_PLANNER_SAFE label is not treated as evidence for any unsupported talent.
Require at least two GALLUS hits totaling 261 arts damage to artillery before the eastern attack sequence. Paper range alone does not satisfy this.

Require artillery death by frame 4344. Forty-four Steward hits in the demonstrated five-attack enhancement pattern total 12753.92; two GALLUS hits bring this to 13014.92. Actual missed attacks or different SP/contact history invalidate that bound.
A shell born before withdrawal remains active. Steward's frame-4350 retreat vacates [2,7]; no other deployed unit or civilian may occupy its 1.2-radius landing area.
Midnight's second arts window must kill the first upper armor before the second late inner runner would exceed Fang's two-block capacity. Account for all outer self-blocking interruptions.
Continuous GALLUS damage must free a Friston slot before armor #34 reaches him. Require an actual BLOCK on #34 and lethal arts contact before its route endpoint.
Audit each civilian through its eastern restraint, western restraint and final objective. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians.
No death is required. A death is acceptable only if its completed contribution and actual successor preserve every remaining duty. Death gives no refund, and actions on the dead operator are invalid.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero enemy leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two protected-target arrivals.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duty: Establish every first contact and both medical sectors. Earlier Midnight crossfire must preserve Fang and Friston; their survival is an economic and containment dependency.
Clear both eastern roadblocks before dangerous civilian confinement. Require upper eastern destruction by frame 2880 and lower eastern destruction before frame 3030.
GALLUS must land at least two arts hits on artillery during its western horizontal passage, after real hostile-priority interruptions.
Hibiscus absorbs her isolated artillery hits. Her first boost starts as soon as its 30-SP charge permits, after the first impact.
Ansel's boost sustains eastern Steward. Hibiscus's second boost covers her later isolated shell sequence. Kill artillery before the mixed armor/shell settlement that killed M61 Steward.
Keep actual inner queues within capacity. Midnight's second skill and GALLUS must kill armor while outer self-blocked targets interrupt Midnight.
Returning Steward clears retained armor and runners. Require actual BLOCK and sufficient DAMAGE on final armor #34.
Destroy both western restraints, then continue until both protected arrivals and complete enemy exhaustion are observed.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP. Require the grants at 570, 1320 and 2070; later income is surplus.
ATK +35% and arts conversion. Conversion is supported by the source skill description and current low-rarity interpreter; the prior plan's refusal to credit it is not retained.
Twenty-second healing boosts, separated by at least thirty inactive seconds. First activation is just after initial readiness, not an assumed deployment-ready skill.
Twenty-five-second healing boosts. First window covers Steward's eastern shell sequence. Assume one healing recipient per attack; no probabilistic extra heal.
Accelerate the first paired officers and later lower-outer pressure.
Supported high-defense priority and automatic enhanced arts hits; no manual skill action.
Generic ordinary arts attacks only. No skill, aura, deployment heal, invented talent or early redeployment.

tactical_thesis: Deploy Midnight before Friston, retain Fang, and replace the additional defender/robot-medic slots with GALLUS². Separate upper and lower medicine so artillery impacts do not splash adjacent patients. GALLUS supplies early artillery chip and permanent lower-inner arts damage; Steward finishes artillery, withdraws from its remaining locked impact point, and returns for final armor. This is an unsimulated, current-model-checkable full-stage hypothesis.
